Source: https://github.com/helixnow/deep-student
Commit: 635216503c0b34bdf812e17942e0f09f51872e6f

translationCache.ts, translationNdjsonParser.ts, translationTypes.ts are read
unchanged from the existing archived upstream tree. selectionRef.ts is newly
archived byte-for-byte in this candidate's upstream directory.

Build extracts exact source slices for SelectionSourceKind, SelectionRefData,
MAX_SELECTION_TEXT_CHARS, describeSelectionLocator, buildSelectionDisplayName
and serializeSelectionRefData. A local t dependency supplies only default label
interpolation. Function bodies are unchanged. Slice hashes and source lines
are recorded in the generated build-manifest.json.

The upstream root license is GNU AGPLv3; the upstream third-party notice states
AGPL-3.0-or-later. Original root notices are copied into the compiled closure's
notices directory. This file records provenance and adaptations, not a decision
about an as-yet unchosen final project distribution arrangement.

New project-owned wrapper: complete-identity namespace, terminal/accounting
gates, immutable cached text, cache-only zero-outbound publication proposal,
strict selected-only bounds, final NDJSON validation and a bounded persistent
stdio helper. These do not import upstream application stores, UI, providers,
Tauri or VFS. They do not dispatch models or modify project business state.

The old selection serializer's overlength truncation is not used as source
authority. Raw selections above20,000 UTF-16 units bypass caching; they are
neither truncated nor silently replaced. Ordinary translation never invokes
the aligned parser. The aligned collector is only a prepared future explicit
aligned-output seam, with the same single project-owned Host run.
